note: Synthetic fixture. It models the durable artifact a real install writes when it inspects a surface. It is not any real surface's capability state.

observations.detail: The install saw the entry event fire on a fresh session.
The install saw the standing stack load and stay loaded.
The install resolved a source identity through the surface's own read path.
The install resolved an authority record through the surface's own read path.

The install inspected the surface's own published trigger interface and found that the surface exposes no trigger-attachment introspection to read. This is a property of the surface. It is not a statement that the inspecting actor lacked a read path.
